findings.description: The bucket is created with no ACL restriction, no public access block, and no bucket policy restricting access; the comments confirm the bucket is intended to be public. This exposes stored objects, including the customer master file, to anonymous readers on the internet.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects such as customer-master.xlsx are stored without enforced server-side encryption (no KMS CMK protection).
No logging block is configured, so unauthorised or anomalous access to this public bucket containing sensitive customer data cannot be detected or investigated.
Versioning is disabled and force_destroy is true, so objects can be silently overwritten or permanently destroyed with no recovery path, weakening data integrity guarantees.
A customer master spreadsheet is uploaded into aws_s3_bucket.data, which is publicly readable and unencrypted, directly exposing sensitive customer records.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for a bucket holding financial data, so contents are stored without enforced encryption using a customer-managed key.
No logging block is configured, so access to financial data is not auditable.
Versioning is disabled and force_destroy is true, allowing irreversible overwrite or deletion of financial records.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is present, so objects are stored without enforced server-side encryption.
No logging block is configured, leaving no audit trail of object-level access to this bucket.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so data science datasets are stored unencrypted at rest.

Like all buckets in this file, the log bucket has no aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource, so account-level ACL/policy protections are not enforced and a future ACL or policy change could expose collected access logs.
force_destroy is true on the central log bucket, permitting deletion of all access logs (including those of data_science) and undermining forensic evidence integrity.
None of the buckets in this file attach a policy denying requests where aws:SecureTransport is false, so objects may be retrieved over unencrypted HTTP connections.
